title: A.I., GATE program, SRA
content: There may be some connection to the mall world and these things. Something much deeper that is yet to be decoded. Perhaps we are being “sent” to mall world for a reason. Has anyone else had a family bloodline deeply involved in freemasonry or other occult groups? I was a GATE child, what is the alleged connection there? The mall world functions like an a.i. dream state, I’m beginning to believe there is a connection, something we all sense but that we haven’t been able to draw a clear connection to. The horrors some people go through in the realm are similar to mind control such as what is talked about by satanic ritual abuse survivors. My dreams are not scary, but they are always uneasy and seem to be leading me towards some deeper beliefs. Or could this be a place to analyze the public’s mind and keep more psychically sensitive people trapped and bound, as to not allow powerful souls to impact the astral plane beyond what is “chosen” for them in mall world. Stay with me here, could this be related to REM soul/conciousness transfer? Are we actually going somewhere that is written into a code which the soul can imprint its self upon? Are we entering into clones or astral bodies used to journey through a liminal place that exists just beyond the physical? I think there is a more esoteric and even scientific connection than just “trippy nostalgic dream world”. It’s like I can feel the answer deep within myself, but am unable to put it into words yet.
